wordings: What's the maximum file size I can upload in one request to the v3 API?
How big can a file be for a single POST to /v3/uploads?
Is there a size limit on v3 uploads?
questions.expected_answer: 200 MB per request (raised from 50 MB in release 3.4.0)

wordings: Which regions can I choose for data residency?
Where can a workspace's data be hosted?
Can we keep our documents in Australia?
questions.expected_answer: eu-west-1 (Dublin), us-east-1 (Virginia) and ap-southeast-2 (Sydney, added in 3.6.0)

wordings: How long is an API key valid, and does rotating it cut off the old one straight away?
When do API keys expire and what happens to the old secret after a rotation?
questions.expected_answer: 60 days for keys issued since the July 2025 policy change; the old secret keeps working for 24 hours after rotation

wordings: Can we keep using the v2 batch endpoint for nightly loads?
questions.expected_answer: No: it is deprecated, removed after 31 December 2025, and replaced by /v3/jobs
